\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 203-206 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R211-first-pass-words-from-chapters-203-206}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for pink and brown.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a century, until now, a deadline, until then, childhood
  \item stairs, a pharmacy, a restaurant, a supermarket, a clothes shop
  \item a tour, a cinema, a building, an upper floor, a police station
  \item a church, a mosque, a hall, a playground, a swimming pool
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A century? (\textbf{\ta{நூற்றாண்டு}}, \emph{nūṟṟāṇṭu}.) Until now? (\textbf{\ta{இதுவரை}}, \emph{ituvarai}.) A deadline? (\textbf{\ta{காலக்கெடு}}, \emph{kālakkeṭu}.) Until then? (\textbf{\ta{அதுவரை}}, \emph{atuvarai}.) Childhood? (\textbf{\ta{குழந்தைப்} \ta{பருவம்}}, \emph{kuḻantaip paruvam}.) Stairs? (\textbf{\ta{படிக்கட்டு}}, \emph{paṭikkaṭṭu}.) A pharmacy? (\textbf{\ta{மருந்துக்கடை}}, \emph{maruntukkaṭai}.) A restaurant? (\textbf{\ta{உணவகம்}}, \emph{uṇavakam}.) A supermarket? (\textbf{\ta{பல்பொருள்} \ta{அங்காடி}}, \emph{palporuḷ aṅkāṭi}.) A clothes shop? (\textbf{\ta{துணிக்கடை}}, \emph{tuṇikkaṭai}.) A tour? (\textbf{\ta{சுற்றுலா}}, \emph{cuṟṟulā}.) A cinema? (\textbf{\ta{திரையரங்கம்}}, \emph{tiraiyaraṅkam}.) A building? (\textbf{\ta{கட்டிடம்}}, \emph{kaṭṭiṭam}.) An upper floor? (\textbf{\ta{மாடி}}, \emph{māṭi}.) A police station? (\textbf{\ta{காவல்} \ta{நிலையம்}}, \emph{kāval nilaiyam}.) A church? (\textbf{\ta{தேவாலயம்}}, \emph{tēvālayam}.) A mosque? (\textbf{\ta{மசூதி}}, \emph{macūti}.) A hall? (\textbf{\ta{கூடம்}}, \emph{kūṭam}.) A playground? (\textbf{\ta{மைதானம்}}, \emph{maitāṉam}.) A swimming pool? (\textbf{\ta{நீச்சல்} \ta{குளம்}}, \emph{nīccal kuḷam}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 207-211 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R211-second-pass-words-from-chapters-207-211}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for in that case and almost.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item in that case, almost, actually, in general, usually
  \item knowledge, a duty, freedom, information, a secret
  \item spoiled, full, empty, tight, loose
  \item the mind, character, jealousy, shyness, surprise
  \item pleasant, friendly, a fool; foolish, pink, brown
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
In that case? (\textbf{\ta{அப்படியானால்}}, \emph{appaṭiyāṉāl}.) Almost? (\textbf{\ta{கிட்டத்தட்ட}}, \emph{kiṭṭattaṭṭa}.) Actually? (\textbf{\ta{உண்மையில்}}, \emph{uṇmaiyil}.) In general? (\textbf{\ta{பொதுவாக}}, \emph{poṭuvāka}.) Usually? (\textbf{\ta{வழக்கமாக}}, \emph{vaḻakkamāka}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\ta{அறிவு}}, \emph{aṟivu}.) A duty? (\textbf{\ta{கடமை}}, \emph{kaṭamai}.) Freedom? (\textbf{\ta{சுதந்திரம்}}, \emph{cutantiram}.) Information? (\textbf{\ta{தகவல்}}, \emph{takaval}.) A secret? (\textbf{\ta{ரகசியம்}}, \emph{rakaciyam}.) Spoiled? (\textbf{\ta{கெட்டுப்போன}}, \emph{keṭṭuppōṉa}.) Full? (\textbf{\ta{நிறைந்த}}, \emph{niṟainta}.) Empty? (\textbf{\ta{காலியான}}, \emph{kāliyāṉa}.) Tight? (\textbf{\ta{இறுக்கமான}}, \emph{iṟukkamāṉa}.) Loose? (\textbf{\ta{தளர்வான}}, \emph{taḷarvāṉa}.) The mind? (\textbf{\ta{மனம்}}, \emph{maṉam}.) Character? (\textbf{\ta{குணம்}}, \emph{kuṇam}.) Jealousy? (\textbf{\ta{பொறாமை}}, \emph{poṟāmai}.) Shyness? (\textbf{\ta{வெட்கம்}}, \emph{veṭkam}.) Surprise? (\textbf{\ta{ஆச்சரியம்}}, \emph{āccariyam}.) Pleasant? (\textbf{\ta{இனிமையான}}, \emph{iṉimaiyāṉa}.) Friendly? (\textbf{\ta{நட்பான}}, \emph{naṭpāṉa}.) A fool; foolish? (\textbf{\ta{முட்டாள்}}, \emph{muṭṭāḷ}.) Pink? (\textbf{\ta{இளஞ்சிவப்பு}}, \emph{iḷañcivappu}.) Brown? (\textbf{\ta{பழுப்பு}}, \emph{paḻuppu}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
